canonical_existing_gate.source: technical/current-specification.md and venture/business-plan.md on run base

required_pairing: candidate arm and B0 fabricated and measured within the same qualified lot
pass_rule: each included Pmax value is stabilized MPP output under prospectively frozen irradiance, temperature, area and tracking criteria
field-generation discriminator is not failed for the same arm
no post-unblinding exclusions outside frozen QC
physical_threshold_note: No new physical threshold is introduced. The 5%/3-lot target is inherited from canonical main; the lower-bound requirement is an uncertainty-robust interpretation of that same target.

synthetic_fixture.units: arbitrary power units; ratios are dimensionless

runtime: Python standard library; tested via repository CI matrix
strong_conventional_explanations: snapshot JV or transient MPP behavior can overstate useful steady electrical work
temperature, irradiance, active-area, contact or series-resistance differences can create apparent Pmax gains
morphology/thickness changes can improve Pmax independently of the proposed EPC/interface mechanism
falsifier: An arm fails useful-work validation if the inherited 5%/3-lot stabilized-Pmax gate is not met robustly, even when DeltaVnr improves.
